cache_key.description: op entry: the key to save under.
cache_key.title: Cache Key

command.description: op key: the command that fetched the data.
command.title: Command

data.description: op entry: the JSON value to save.
data.title: Data

expand.description: op key, workspaces list: the --expand values, in order.
expand.title: Expand

files.description: op index: relative paths (with /) of the files in a cache folder; each has some content.
files.title: Files

metadata.description: op entry: request metadata to save with it, if any.
metadata.title: Metadata

now.description: op entry: the local time of the save, as an ISO 8601 string like 2024-01-02T03:04:05.123456.
now.title: Now

odata_filter.description: op key, workspaces list: the --odata-filter value, if given.
odata_filter.title: Odata Filter

role.description: op key, apps list: the --role value.
role.title: Role

top.description: op key, workspaces list: the --top value.
top.title: Top

user_id.description: op key, users user-access: the --user-id value.
user_id.title: User Id
